defects.what: The still is split into two stacked comic panels (Indio holding M, then a close embrace) with a white divider.
The gold tablet at the centre is covered in scribbled pseudo-text, some glyphs look Korean, not the tablet's real script.
The dealership shows a 7-Eleven-like green-red logo and large red letters 'HOE' above Indio.
The school sign and banner on the right carry large gibberish words ('OAO-SOA', 'QUEEN S'), and a stray watermark sits in the bottom-left corner.
A lit shop sign behind M reads a misspelled 'QUZZION' and the wall posters carry pseudo-text.
The ring of glyphs around Indio's head is pseudo-Chinese/Korean characters rather than abstract symbols.
Mall shop signs behind Indio show partial letters and his jacket patch has pseudo-letters.
Small pseudo-letters and currency-like symbols ring the coin and float in the sparkles.
A board on the wall behind Indio shows pseudo-letters ('AI').
Shelf labels in the garage and the tank badge carry small pseudo-letters.
The hologram panel shows rows of tiny pseudo-text in its interface.
The hologram list has a pseudo-letter heading ('LL').
The round plaque in the lens has a rim of pseudo-letters.
The banknotes in the wallet carry pseudo-text and digits ('0100').
Shop signs on the left and the bus destination board show small pseudo-letters.
Indio is drawn shirtless with spiky red-brown hair beside the creature in the cold open.
Indio seen from behind has brown hair and no topknot.
The man taken for Indio has brown hair, no headband and no topknot.
Indio on the dock has red-brown hair.
Indio and M both have brown hair, and Indio wears a dark jacket instead of his outfit.
Indio has brown hair and a brown hoodie, and M has brown hair.
